annotations.title: Eisenstein Conditions for X³-3 at p=3
annotations.body: The five conditions for Eisenstein at p=3: (1) (3) is prime, (2) leading coeff 1 ∉ (3), (3) coeff(k) ∈ (3) for k < degree, (4) degree > 0, (5) coeff(0) = -3 ∉ (9). The hardest is (5): show ¬ 9 ∣ 3 using Int.le_of_dvd and nlinarith.

annotations.title: Gauss's Lemma Transfer to ℚ
annotations.body: IsPrimitive.Int.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_cast: a primitive polynomial irreducible over ℤ is irreducible over ℚ. The convert step aligns the coefficient cast via coeff_sub and coeff_X_pow.

annotations.title: Real Power Root Computation
annotations.body: Show (3^(1/3))^3 = 3 using Real.rpow_natCast and Real.rpow_mul: (x^y)^z = x^(y*z). With y=1/3 and z=3: x^(1/3*3) = x^1 = x.
